title: Transcriptome of chronic myelomonocytic leukemia
description: We report the gene expression of human chronic myelomonocytic leukemia by performing whole transcriptome shotgun sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells of patients with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia. Overall design: Comparison of gene expression between proliferative and dysplastic chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.
